title: Composed supervisory control: Pause/resume sequence with abort recovery -> Paused three-stage sequence with abort and per-stage timeout

outputs.name: A_State
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 idle, 1 step1, 2 step2, 3 done

outputs.name: B_Fault
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Abort or timeout lockout

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 idle, 1 stage1, 2 stage2, 3 stage3

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Pausing resets rather than accumulates the stage timeout.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Start shall begin Step 1 only when idle and not A_Aborted.
requirements.property: G((A_State=0 AND A_Start AND !A_Aborted AND !A_Abort) -> X(A_State=1))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Advance shall move Step 1 to Step 2 and Step 2 to done only while not A_Paused.
requirements.property: G((A_Advance AND !A_Paused AND A_State=1)->X(A_State=2)) AND G((A_Advance AND !A_Paused AND A_State=2)->X(A_State=3))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Pause shall suppress active step outputs without losing A_State; A_Resume clears A_Paused.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Abort shall return A_State to idle, suppress outputs, clear A_Paused, and latch A_Aborted.
requirements.property: G(A_Abort -> (A_State=0 AND !A_Step1 AND !A_Step2 AND !A_Paused AND A_Aborted))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Aborted only while A_Start, A_Advance, A_Pause, A_Resume, and A_Abort are all FALSE.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Start in idle shall enter stage 1; each matching Done input advances exactly one stage, and B_Stage3Done returns idle with a one-scan B_Complete pulse.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Pause shall retain B_State while forcing every actuator FALSE; Done inputs while B_Paused shall not advance.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: The active stage shall time out after 500 ms of unpaused execution and latch B_Fault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Abort shall immediately return idle, force safe outputs, and latch B_Fault.
requirements.property: G(B_Abort -> (B_State=0 AND B_Fault AND !B_Actuator1 AND !B_Actuator2 AND !B_Actuator3))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset clears B_Fault only in idle while B_Start, B_Abort, and every Done input are FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: At most one actuator may be TRUE, and B_Complete shall never coincide with an actuator.
A TRUE A_Step1 shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
